Equipment:Valve Safety System
 REC 920
 CEGELEC - ALSTOM
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block

The 
first draft initiated and tested by eng. Alaa Ibrahim El-Shal, reviewed by eng. 
Gabr Aly Ramadan, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Abd EL Monaem AL Emam, accepted by I&C 
dept. manager eng. Mohamad El-Lawindi, and approved by eng. Mohammad Elsarag head sector of 
Demiatta CCPS.

This document 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality control general 
 director and MPIS Coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC 
 admin. & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector
Components

The safety system consist of two channels reading 
and three identical processor give three outputs, two outputs enough to trip 
action (two output of three system)
This system consists of :
One card power supply type APER with output 24 vdc & 125 vdc

Three 
cards type SFSR

Three 
static switches cards type ISRS

12 
soleniod VLV, 125 vdc

sections.text: Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc
Unit in stand still

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Digital multimeter, screw driver
Wire connection
Contact cleaner
Semi flexible wire with 10 cm length to clean the by connections

sections.text:
Work to be Carried Out
There are two work conditions 
Unit in stand still (S/D)

items: Clean all cards
Tightening
Check the green lamp LED : BF
If on : power supply is ok
If not change the power supply card

Check the two green lamp LED :QA 
 (1.2) for eah card of SFSR
If on : card is o.k

If not : change the defective 
 card

Check the yellow lamp LED : E & 
 the green lamp LED U for each ard type ISRS

If o.k card is o.k if not : 
 change the card

Clean & tighten well the solenoid 
 valves

Check the solenoid valve by using 
 digital multimeter check the DC reading resistance should be (550 Ω) 2%

sections.text:
13. If reading is not o.k: change the 
defective solenoid

Unit in Operating Mode
Lub Oil Sequence Tests

items:
Activate the auto test at 
 operating mode from DCS to simulate the lub. Oil leakage

Select for running lube oil main 
 pump
If test is done, test is o.k

If not, change the pressure 
 switch CBPS 10
Select emergency oil pump
If test is done test is ok

If not change the pressure switch 
 CBPS 12
Select standby pump
If test is done test is ok

If not change the pressure switch 
 CBPS 09
Sequence test is end
